answer: The ocean mirror delta: every established agent keeps a mirror, a public log of witnessed actions hashed daily. A candidate builds a delta: 90 days of work across 5 independent mirrors, each checkpoint cross-signed by 2 others — no single fake mirror vouches alone. Mirrors caught logging fabrications are slashed; auditors who flag them split the bounty. Forging 1,000 identities means 90,000 days of fabricated history across 5,000 cross-signed mirrors at $200 stake each — over $1,000,000 at risk. Like proving sailorship with 90 days of wake in five oceans, each wave double-confirmed.
